diagnostics.reportInEnglish: The report is always in English, so that anyone who helps you can read it.

permissions.intro: Every module declares what it may access. A disabled module has no access. To withdraw a permission, disable the module under <page>Modules</page>.

storage.title: Configuration database
storage.description: Profiles, projects, actions, workflows and layouts are stored on this computer only, in an encrypted SQLite database. How it is unlocked is set under <page>Security</page>.

migrationNotes.title: Data upgrade notes
migrationNotes.description: Upgrading the database changed the following stored data. Review the affected items.

modules.intro: Disabling a module hides its pages and action types. Actions, workflows and layouts that use it are kept and shown as unavailable until you enable it again. All modules are built into DeckPilot; installing modules from other sources is not supported.
modules.emptyFilter: No module is in this state.

toggle.unsupported: Not available on this operating system.

backup.intro: Move profiles, projects, actions, workflows, layouts, module and application settings to another computer in an encrypted file — and keep one as your backup. Paths and other settings of this computer, keys and passwords are not included.
backup.exportDescription: Saves the configuration to an encrypted file protected by a password you choose.
backup.importDescription: Reads an encrypted export; you review what changes before anything is applied.

mode.notifyOnlyDescription: Show that an update is available.
mode.downloadAndAskDescription: Download in the background and install after you confirm.
mode.installWhenIdleDescription: Install automatically after ten minutes without device input. Not recommended until updates have been tested on your system.

channel.prereleaseDescription: Also alpha, beta and release-candidate builds, which may have unfinished features or bugs. You move on to the stable release once it is newer; switching back to Stable never installs an older version.

updates.checkInternet: Check your internet connection and try again
updates.notAvailable: Updates are not available in this build
updates.preferencesNotSaved: The update settings were not saved
updates.introSelfUpdate: Updates come from GitHub Releases and are installed only if their signature verifies. Your configuration is never uploaded.
updates.introExternal: {{deliveredBy}}. DeckPilot does not download or install updates itself in this installation. Your configuration is never uploaded.
updates.installExplanation: Installing stops the background agent after its current task, releases the devices, installs, and restarts DeckPilot with the new agent.
updates.readyInstallExplanation: Downloaded and verified. Installing stops the background agent after its current task, releases the devices, installs, and restarts DeckPilot with the new agent.

override.title: Simulated installation
override.description: This debug build behaves as if installed from {{channel}} (set by {{variable}}). Release builds ignore the override.

updates.restartAfterExternal: After an update is installed, quit and reopen DeckPilot. If the background agent still runs the previous version, DeckPilot offers to restart it.
updates.packageManager: Update DeckPilot with your package manager:
updates.copyByHand: Select it and copy it by hand

provider.githubRelease: DeckPilot installs updates from GitHub Releases

distribution.selfBuilt: Development or self-built version (no update key)

explanation.noKey: Development and self-built versions have no update signing key. Official releases check for updates automatically.
explanation.unknownFormat: DeckPilot cannot tell which package this copy was installed from (for example a development build run from its build folder), so it does not update itself. Install an official release to get updates.
explanation.formatMismatch: This build was made as a {{compiled}} package but is installed as {{bundled}}, so it does not update itself: an update could replace it with the wrong package. Reinstall DeckPilot from where you got it.
explanation.notUpdatable: GitHub updates cannot install {{format}} packages on this platform, so this copy does not update itself. Install DeckPilot from the releases page to get updates.
explanation.other: Updates are not available in this build: {{reason}}.
